blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cebuano standout Jared Bahay delivered a solid performance as Ateneo de Manila University opened its emotional UAAP Season 89 campaign with a commanding 101–74 victory over the University of the East on Wednesday at the SM Mall of Asia Arena.
